summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, announcing a routine board chair succession. Scott Powers will retire as chair and from the board following the May 5, 2027 annual meeting, with Joseph Natale set to succeed him upon re-election. No material terms, prices, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is an ordinary leadership transition disclosure, not a forced departure or strategic event. There are no deal terms, advisors, or regulatory implications. The filing is informational only, with no actionable special-situation angle for investors.
